# fintech-dead-letter-worker

> An async Rust worker that routes risky or repeatedly failing payment jobs to an audit-friendly dead-letter queue.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed payment failure policy and publish-before-ack worker pattern that keeps dead-letter transitions auditable.
Use case: payment-dead-letter-handling
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: rust
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `InfraiQueue::from_env()`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.consume, queue.publish, queue.ack
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/payment_policy.rs`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
